rows.text: You enter a hotel on the Alda Star System on the brink of death. You have no idea why, but it seems that all of the residents here seem extremely slow and absent-minded with everything they do.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The long and drawn-out docking registration process has destroyed your patience and the alien bacteria extermination process has sent you into a long, 20-hour period of fasting.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You open up a food ordering app with great expectation, but the vile beast of decision paralysis immediately grips your mind as your eyes are dazzled with endless menu options, causing your already exhausted mind to descend into blankness.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You immediately realize that you have encountered the second most challenging philosophical conundrum in the universe — What to eat?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: When in doubt, order whatever looks the most familiar.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You decided to throw yourself to the wolves and order the strangest thing on the menu.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The big data will provide the answers.
Next time, you'll receive more accurate menu recommendations.

The app selects a dozen recommendations for you based on your cultural background and your biological characteristics. Yet you scroll through them all, still unable to reach a conclusion. As it keeps refreshing its recommendations for you, you can't help but think they're either too oily or too bland, or...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: It finally asks you: "Is there anything you really want to eat? Just tell me, anything."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I am a useless, trash app. Please consult another app that may be of assistance to you." It recommends another ordering app to you and sends you some money for food.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The growls of your stomach grow louder.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
